author: Coda 1
purpose: Explicit, dated exemption list for LEGACY Smart Note captures that predate the mechanical SN-002 governance keys. This is debt, not permission.
why_a_ratchet: Flipping CI to blocking --check today would fail every merge on 10 historical captures for reasons unrelated to any current change. A ratchet blocks the drift class going forward WITHOUT reddening main on debt that already exists, and it makes the debt visible instead of invisible.
invariants: This list may only ever SHRINK. A capture removed from it must be genuinely repaired.
A capture NOT in this list must pass governance conformance or CI fails.
Adding an entry is a governance decision and requires review; it is not a fix.
tests/test_sn002_conformance.py asserts this list does not grow.
